description.value: Urban Liquor Store is a privately owned wine-specialist liquor store in Kelowna, staffed by WSET-certified sommeliers, Cicerone-trained beer specialists, and wine scholars who offer personalized guidance. Located in the heart of BC's premier wine region, it curates craft beers, local pet nat and piquette wines, innovative spirits, and ciders. Cyclists passing through wine country can also take advantage of local delivery services and online ordering.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is accessible and clearly belongs to Urban Liquor Store in Kelowna, confirming the business is active. However, a significant address discrepancy exists: OSM records 2395 Gordon Drive (V1W 3X7, unit 106) while the website consistently lists 1191 Gordon Drive, Kelowna BC V1Y 3E5 across all pages — the OSM record may be outdated or incorrect. No website content addresses bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or cycling-specific amenities, so all such fields default to null.
concerns: Address mismatch: OSM records 2395 Gordon Drive, unit 106, V1W 3X7; website consistently shows 1191 Gordon Drive, Kelowna BC V1Y 3E5 across all pages. OSM node may be at wrong location or outdated.
Name mismatch: OSM uses 'Urban Liquor'; website uses 'Urban Liquor Store'.
Phone not present in OSM; sourced from website only.
URL discovery confidence flagged as 'medium' — address discrepancy partly supports this uncertainty, though name and city match.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The business is a legitimate and cyclist-relevant stop in BC wine country, but the OSM address (2395 Gordon Drive, V1W 3X7) conflicts with the website address (1191 Gordon Drive, V1Y 3E5) — the OSM node may be mislocated or refer to a former location. Address must be verified before listing.
enrichment_extras.notes: The website also shows a logged-in placeholder account (filler@godaddy.com), suggesting the site is built on a GoDaddy template and may not fully reflect all current store details.
